summary: Studio has a right-aligned profile menu that loads a public Google client ID at runtime, accepts a Google Identity Services credential, and offers a dev-only native credential-submission check.

origin.authority: Snapshot only; referenced live source and tests are authoritative and may have changed after this record.

evidence.note: Implements the profile trigger, Google sign-in placement, sign-out action, and native development check UI.
Loads Google Identity Services and renders its button outside React-managed button content.
Serves the public Google client identifier only for configured Google OIDC.
Implements the dev-only native submission validation with a redacted identifier fingerprint and no session issuance.
